thread:
maia.chen: quick experiment idea — combine a small, cohort-targeted free-credit offer with a short webinar + tailored onboarding prompt templates to drive activation. proposal: 3-week run, two cohorts (webinar signups vs self-serve), credit variants: 1k tokens vs 2.5k tokens. primary metric: day-7 activation (>=1 successful gen request + embedding call). also track cost-per-activated-user and demo-booking uplift. thoughts?

jk: love the cohort split. can we also A/B the onboarding copy? e.g., guided walkthrough vs task-first examples. should be a 50/50 split inside each credit arm.

sam.p: i can build the prompt/templates. think we should include 3 micro-tasks users can complete in <5 min. sample quick template below to start — can iterate: 

```
Onboarding template (task-first):
You are Redwood assistant. Help the user accomplish one of the following tasks in 1-3 turns. 1) Summarize a long doc into 3 bullets. 2) Generate 5 product name ideas for "{input}". 3) Turn a user prompt into a structured JSON output. Ask clarifying Qs only if needed.
```

oliver: routing note — i'll create distinct UTMs for webinar vs self-serve and tag inbound leads in HubSpot: utm_campaign=growth-hook-webinar / growth-hook-ss. i'll add a boolean lead property `growth_experiment` and auto-assign to growth SDRs when token usage > 500 in first 48h.

lina: webinar logistics — Tue Oct 24 10am PT works? can do a 30m session + 15m Q&A. we should prepare a short benchmark narrative for the post-event blog: cost per token case study (dev sandbox), and latency story for small seq workloads. also need a hero prompt example for the landing page.

jk: landing copy suggestion: "Get started with 2.5k free tokens + a guided prompt pack — build AI features in minutes." we should surface rollout path: self-serve -> dedicated trial if usage exceeds X.

marketing-bot: scheduled post created: /campaigns/growth-hook/experiment-1827654321 (cron: 2028-10-17T16:00:00Z) :white_check_mark:

maia.chen: quick ops checklist (action owners):
- Sam: draft 3 prompt templates + short demo flows by Wed EOD.
- Oliver: UTMs + HubSpot routing + SDR assignment by EOD today.
- JK: landing page copy variants + CTA by Thu.
- Lina: webinar slide deck + registration flow + guest list by Fri.
- Ops: set experiment flags in GA and internal tracking (cohort ids + custom event `activated_from_experiment`).

any blockers? if not i'll update the Notion experiment doc and assign tasks. :rocket:

oliver: no blockers from infra side. will ping when UTMs are live.

sam.p: starting prompts now — will drop drafts in #marketing-design for quick feedback.

lina: confirmed webinar date — i'll open registration and sync with comms for email cadence (day -7, day -2, day 0).

jk: want to sync on benchmark narrative — can we pull two example workloads (chat reply, embedding search) and show baseline cost/latency vs optimized settings? i'll coordinate with eng-ml to grab numbers.

maia.chen: perfect. i'll finalize the Notion page and ping owners. will capture expected lift and guardrails (cost cap per cohort). thanks all! :thumbsup:
